sense: a drawing of an area that shows the way

pins.definition: A drawing of a specific area that shows roads, towns, or geographic features to help you find your way.
A drawing of a country or region showing features like roads, rivers, and cities.
A drawing or plan of an area showing roads, cities, and landmarks.

situation: A driver lost on a dark country road spreads a large folded paper chart across the steering wheel to find the route.
subject: the map
brief: A large, brightly lit paper roadmap with intricate lines of red and blue roads is spread out across a dark car steering wheel. A finger traces a winding path across the paper grid, perfectly illuminating the detailed cartography against the dark cabin.
prompt: A large, brightly lit paper roadmap with intricate lines of red and blue roads is spread out across a dark car steering wheel. A finger traces a winding path across the paper grid, perfectly illuminating the detailed cartography against the dark cabin. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
